name: DurableSubscriber
summary: Has the messaging system keep the messages published while it was disconnected, so that going away is not the same as declining to hear.

roles.name: DurableSubscriber
roles.summary: A subscriber whose subscription outlives its connection. Nothing about it differs while it is connected, which is exactly why the intent has to be declared rather than read off the code: the whole pattern is a behaviour visible only during an absence.
